sources.cite: Python 3.15 documentation, The Python Tutorial, 7. Input and Output (7.2 Reading and Writing Files)
sources.note: Read 2026-11-17 through a summarizing fetch. "'w' for only writing (an existing file with the same name will be erased)"; "'a' opens the file for appending; any data written to the file is automatically added to the end"; with closes the file 'even if an exception is raised'; without it, writes may not be 'completely written to the disk'.
